title: One-click three-tier ability differentiation (LA / MA / HA)
summary: One button → three concurrent calls to aiDifferentiateExistingWorksheet (low / middle / high), Promise.allSettled so one failure doesn't block the other two. Tabbed preview shows all three. 'Save all three to library' triggers AppContext.saveWorksheet × 3 with linked metadata.differentiationGroup so HoDs can find them as a set.
motivation: Twinkl PlanIt's three-way LA / MA / HA differentiated worksheets are the most-praised primary feature — most UK primary teachers plan in tiers. Today the send-assistant differentiate flow is one-tier-at-a-time. The 4-call AI cost is acceptable because the result feeds three lessons, not one.

in: client/src/lib/threeTierDifferentiation.ts (new, ~150 LoC) — wraps the existing aiDifferentiateExistingWorksheet with three concurrent tier calls
client/src/components/ThreeTierButton.tsx (new, ~100 LoC) — toolbar button + tabbed preview modal
shared/aiSchemas.ts — additive: metadata.differentiationGroup?: { groupId: string; tier: 'LA'|'MA'|'HA' }
server/routes/worksheetLibrary.ts — index column on metadata.differentiationGroup.groupId so the library query 'show all 3 versions' is fast
Targeted vitest: three-call concurrency, partial-failure recovery, group-link metadata stamped on each tier
out: Custom tier counts (5-tier / 2-tier) — deferred; v1 is fixed 3
Per-tier SEND profile mixing — deferred (would conflict with the existing SEND fidelity audit's single-profile assumption)
Differentiation 'preview-before-commit' — deferred; v1 commits all three immediately

acceptance_criteria: All three tier calls run concurrently (Promise.allSettled, not sequential await).
If two of three calls succeed, the modal shows the two and a toast for the failed one with a 'Retry just HA' button.
All three saved worksheets share the same groupId and have linked tier values.
HoD library view filter 'Show only differentiation groups' returns at most one row per groupId (collapsed display).
Cost transparency chip (PR-9) reflects 3× generation cost stamped on the parent group's metadata.

risk_register.risk: Three concurrent calls hit per-school throttle
risk_register.mitigation: Server adapts cooldown tracker (already in routes/ai.ts:75-115) to honour a per-group queue; concurrency limit of 3 is well under any practical school throttle.

risk_register.risk: LA / HA versions diverge so much that the 'they're the same lesson' invariant breaks
risk_register.mitigation: Differentiation prompt already preserves the same specRef set (Phase F lock). The tier filter on getCandidatePoolForTopics ensures spec coverage stays aligned.

related: FEAT-PF1 — curriculum bank's tier filter (consumed by all three calls)
